title: Tracking area updating for access to RLOS not accepted by the network

entities.name: Tracking area updating for access to RLOS not accepted
entities.description: Procedure executed when tracking area updating request for access to RLOS is rejected by the network, involving specific UE behaviors based on rejection conditions and EMM state.

entities.name: Search for suitable cell in E-UTRAN
entities.description: Condition where rejection action involves searching for a suitable cell in E-UTRAN radio access technology.

entities.name: Select GERAN or UTRAN or disable E-UTRAN capability
entities.description: Condition where rejection action involves attempting to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology or disabling E-UTRAN capability.

entities.name: Same selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE is in the same selected PLMN where the last tracking area updating procedure was attempted and rejected.

entities.name: EMM cause value other than #9, #10, #40
entities.description: Condition where tracking area updating procedure was rejected with an EMM cause value other than #9, #10, and #40.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that must not be running for certain UE actions after tracking area updating rejection.

entities.name: Detach locally
entities.description: UE behavior to detach locally if not already detached, followed by PLMN selection to attempt EPS attach for access to RLOS via another PLMN.

entities.name: PLMN selection
entities.description: Procedure to select a new PLMN according to 3GPP TS 23.122 to attempt EPS attach for access to RLOS.

entities.name: EMM state
entities.description: EMM state of the UE, which influences whether tracking area updating or attach procedure is attempted after rejection.

relations.description: Procedure behavior is guarded by condition to search for suitable cell in E-UTRAN.
Procedure behavior is guarded by condition to select GERAN/UTRAN or disable E-UTRAN capability.
Condition to search E-UTRAN requires consideration of EMM state for subsequent procedure selection.
Condition of same PLMN establishes the property to detach locally and perform PLMN selection.
Condition of excluded EMM cause values establishes the property to detach locally and perform PLMN selection.
Property to detach locally is guarded by timer T3346 not running.
Property to detach locally includes the step to perform PLMN selection.
